notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.2 Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]EvilPunk Hotfix 1.4.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

notes.title: Dev Diary #03 | Hotfix 1.4 Released and Rogue Like
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Evil Punk development diary. With update 1.4 released in previous week. Most game breaking bugs are fixed and optimization issues mostly handled. Except stutter in church.
 
Today we are going to focus on whats coming in 1.4.1 patch, what we achieved in 1.4 release and Rogue like update.
 
 
In 1.4 patch we fixed sizeable amount of bugs glitches and performance issues.
 
Also since our starting area looks more like a polygon area than a church, we wanted to make this work with our game. Of course, our area was very large and players got lost easily, so we reduced the area by a third and focused on just what the player needed to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/cf51faef4c419dd4c874780ef4b72091cd49a2c6.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/628c71f277da66a8eb8f3757882bb921afebdd60.png[/img]
We also tried to make a map selection screen that was out of the ordinary, but we got feedback from the player base about how difficult it was to select a map and it also didn't give enough information about the level. So we redesigned the Level Select screen to make it easy to enter the map with just two clicks and to see all the map information at a glance for you to better understand!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/eb3631ed3edee8b54facb1d1d72a152e4e08ca89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/98ae8d3304f1b50f90920f7b507c7102c8dba1a3.png[/img]
(Also we added a timer to our wave indicator!)
 
 In addition, according to the feedbacsk, it was not fully understood what the power-ups falling from the enemies were due to their visual effects. We adjusted the effects to make them more visible and to make their shapes more obvious.
 
About our next updates Rogue like game mode is on the process of development and planned to release in January.
 
Right now we can only show you how our freeze cards effects work on our turret.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/9511764503122e0c31d182311516d56404566ddb.png[/img]
(Work In Progress)
 
Also about this week we are gona release another and final hotfix patch called 1.4.1 for remaining bugs and glitches. We are also trying to solve stutter issues on some devices!
 
We will continue to collect your feedback and make adjustments and fixes as a result. For now though, that’s all for today. See you on the next dev log!

notes.title: HOTFIX v1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Sheriffs,[/b]
We’ve just released a new Major Hotfix to enhance your gaming experience and address some of the feedback we’ve received from our amazing community. Below is a detailed list of the improvements and fixes included in this update:
 
[b]Improvements:[/b]
 
[b]Starting Area:[/b] First of all, we completely redesigned our Starting Area, reducing its size and making it more functional. And now you can also try out the grenades and turrets available in the game in the Shooting Range! (Even our Priest standing in the church is shocked by this situation and looks like he won't be able to speak for a while.)
[b]Level Select:[/b] We've completely removed the 3D map table and replaced it with a more informative and easy to understand UI.
[b]Tutorial:[/b] We've updated our Tutorial screens with a new start area. We've tried to make it more understandable for everyone with less text and more icons.
[b]Sitting Mode: [/b]In Pause Menu you can now adjust the Belt's height, left and right, and forward and backward.
[b]UI Improvements & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed extra health indicators on weapons. And the icons for church and player lives have been changed to make them easier to distinguish.
[*] When you deal damage to an Enemy, a grey bar now appears on their health bar.
[*] The quality of the money labels in the game has been improved. and now our money appears on every table in the Wave Shop.
[*] Pause Menu, the win and die screen now has "Return to Base and "Level Select" options.
[*] The time you spend on the level is now visible on the Wave Board.
[*] There is now a Master Setting in the Pause Menu.
[*] Fixed the range of increased stat values in the Upgrade Table.
[/list]
[b]Grenades:[/b] The throwing power has been increased to make it easier to throw.
[b]Bosses[/b]
[list]
[*] The footsteps of the Boss on the first map are no longer global. It has been made easier to understand where it comes from.
[*] We reduced the effects of the boss in the first map to improve performance.
[*] The attacks of the Boss on the second map have been improved.
[*] Weapons in Shop Wave: The magazines that come with purchasing a weapon in Shop Wave have been positioned more clearly and their number has been increased.
[/list]
 
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Let's start with the most annoying ones first.
[*] Fixed the issue where bombs could not be thrown and would go underground when thrown.
[*] Fixed the issue where objects falling in the church area would go underground.
[*] Fixed the issue where health drops from enemies were not being picked up properly.
[*] Fixed the UI overlay issue when the magazine is placed on the belt.
[*] Last Enemy Indicator: The last remaining enemy on the map being displayed in red now works properly.
[*] Fixed the issue where Turrets would exceed their maximum limit when purchased from Shop Waves and chests.
[*] Fixed the issue where a Tank zombie would go into strange animations when it was shot in the leg area.
[*] Fixed the issue where ranged enemies could not hit us while in Seated Mode.
[*] The issue where church and player health was not reaching its maximum value when gaining health in Shop Wave has been fixed, and the damage sound is no longer played when buying player health.
[*] Fixed the issue where bosses could not gain shields at certain health levels. This way, boss phases are now working properly. (They won't die that easily anymore)
[/list]
 
 
Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’re committed to making EvilPunk the best experience it can be. As always, please let us know your thoughts on these updates in the Steam Community Hub or through our social media channels.
 
[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and enjoy your time in the world of EvilPunk!
 
Best regards,
The EvilPunk Team[/b]

notes.title: Optimization Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Sheriffs,[/b]

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback about the recent SteamVR and performance issues, and we’ve implemented critical updates to improve your gameplay experience. Here’s what we’ve addressed:

- Fixed SteamVR compability issue. Now you can play with SteamVR. 
- Resolved key problems causing high CPU and GPU usage.
- Optimized the game for smoother performance without compromising visual quality.
- Made render and game thread more efficent and suitable for our fast action phased gameplay.

We are working harder every day to provide you with a better experience. Your feedback and ideas are very valuable to us.If you encounter any issues please reach us from discord and other platforms.

See you in the next update&patch.

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Sheriffs![/b]

As always, please report any bugs on our Discord or Steam page!
Your feedback is invaluable to us! Keep sharing your thoughts and help us improve the game. We appreciate your support—enjoy the game!
